name: Kashmiri Walnuts
origin: Shelled in the valleys of Shopian
story: Thin-shelled walnuts from old, rain-fed trees — never irrigated, never forced. Shelled by hand in winter, so a few halves come whole and a few come broken.
note: Bitter-sweet and oily — the way the mountain makes them.

maker.name: The Bhat family
maker.blurb: Custodians of walnut trees older than anyone living. Ghritam pays per tree, not per kilo, so a lean year still pays for the family's winter.
